verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud is built API-first. The docs cover programmatic access to its core functions: creating agent runs, multi-run sessions, cursor-polled event streams that can drive a custom UI, launching and stopping browsers over CDP, and saved login profiles. A published OpenAPI 3.1 spec (v2/v3/v4) and an official MCP server back this up. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or comparison confirming API–UI feature parity, API coverage of account and dashboard functions such as billing, concurrency and API keys, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
